name: main
sql: SELECT band, avg(cost) AS avg_cost, count() AS calls FROM (SELECT multiIf(ctx < 100000, '0-100k', ctx < 200000, '100-200k', ctx < 400000, '200-400k', '400k+') AS band, CostUsd AS cost FROM (SELECT InputTokens + CacheReadTokens + CacheCreationTokens AS ctx, CostUsd FROM agent_session_events WHERE EventKind = 'model_call' AND TimeUnixMs >= {dashboard_context_period_start:DateTime} AND TimeUnixMs < {dashboard_context_period_end:DateTime})) GROUP BY band
